note: Public template pack. Families a and b are the original dev wording; family c was held out once and is now public (burned). Private held-out families live in a separate pack (see MANO_EVAL_TEMPLATE_PACK) with this same schema; the private pack is published after the final run. Pack author rules: leads and consequences must carry {due1} and {due2}; requirement sentences must use the need templates so canonical names always appear; never put trigger phrases (we need, send your, bring your, include, enclose, attach your, must include, return your) next to anything but a keyed name; conditional sentences must start with If.

a.missingAgainUtility: Bring your {Doc} to our office so we can set up your payment plan in one visit.

medicaid_renewal.subject: {program} Renewal
medicaid_renewal.lead: Your {program} {coverage} is up for {formShort}. To keep your {coverage} without a break, your completed {formShort} packet must arrive {due1}.
medicaid_renewal.interview: Your phone interview is scheduled for {interview}. We will call you at the number we have on file. If you miss the call, call us at {tel} within 2 business days to reschedule.
medicaid_renewal.consequence: If we do not receive your packet {due2}, your {program} {coverage} will end on {end}. You may reapply, but there may be a gap.

missing_docs.subject: Missing Documents for Your {program} Case
missing_docs.lead: We are working on your {program} case and need one more item to finish: your {doc}. Send a copy {due1}. Do not send originals.
missing_docs.extra: You can send it by mail in the enclosed envelope, bring it to our office at {officeAddr}, or call {tel} if you cannot get this document on time.
missing_docs.consequence: If we do not receive your {doc} {due2}, we may deny or close your case. If that happens you will get another notice with appeal rights.

work_hours.subject: {program} Work Hours Report
work_hours.lead: Your hours report for this month must arrive {due1}.
work_hours.extra: If you cannot meet the hours because of illness, caregiving, or another good cause, tell us and send any proof you have.
work_hours.consequence: If we do not receive your hours {due2}, your {program} benefits may change starting {end}.

utility_shutoff.subject: Past Due Account
utility_shutoff.lead: Your utility account is past due. The amount of {amount} was due on {past}. Pay in full or arrange a payment plan {due1} to avoid shutoff.
utility_shutoff.middle:
To set up a plan, call {utilTel} Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, or visit our office. If service is shut off on or after {end}, a reconnection fee applies.

If you receive benefits or have a medical need for continuous service, call us right away to discuss options.
